nodes.name: adapt.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive web adaptation guide covering responsive breakpoints, touch targets, layout patterns, responsive images, and verification across mobile, tablet, desktop, print, and email contexts.

nodes.name: adapt.native.md
nodes.summary: Native adaptation workflow for scaling phone layouts to tablets, handling orientation and foldables, cross-platform iOS/Android differences, and porting web experiences to native runtimes.

nodes.name: android.md
nodes.summary: Android platform conformance checklist evaluating layout structure, touch targets, typography, color theming, components, motion, and build verification against Material expectations.

nodes.name: animate.md
nodes.summary: Motion design command that defines an animation thesis, selects material by meaning, sets timing and easing, implements to the target runtime, and verifies accessibility controls.

nodes.name: audit.md
nodes.summary: Web implementation diagnostic scanning accessibility, performance, theming, responsive design, and implementation integrity, then generating a scored audit report with prioritized actions.

nodes.name: audit.native.md
nodes.summary: Native app audit workflow evaluating VoiceOver and TalkBack accessibility, performance, appearance, platform conformance, adaptivity, and producing a conformance verdict report.

nodes.name: bolder.md
nodes.summary: Visual amplification command that diagnoses flat interfaces, intensifies hierarchy and presence within fixed scope, and validates the result with a skeleton test.

nodes.name: clarify.md
nodes.summary: UX copy refinement workflow auditing interface language, rewriting actions, forms, errors, and state messages, and verifying voice, accessibility, and localization quality.

nodes.name: colorize.md
nodes.summary: Color strategy command that audits existing palettes, chooses an application strategy, applies tokens at system scale, and verifies contrast and perceptual consistency.

nodes.name: component-review.md
nodes.summary: Structured component review workflow for preparing a component kit, presenting variants to stakeholders, and assembling findings into a focused review session.

nodes.name: craft-floor.md
nodes.summary: Minimum craft quality bar defining verification criteria and explicit refusal conditions for design output that falls below acceptable standards.

nodes.name: craft.md
nodes.summary: Deprecated alias pointing agents to the craft-floor quality standards reference instead of maintaining a separate craft command.

nodes.name: critique.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive design critique orchestration combining design review, browser evidence, cognitive load assessment, Nielsen heuristics scoring, persona red flags, and persisted snapshot reporting.

nodes.name: delight.md
nodes.summary: Delight design command identifying emotional opportunities, defining a single delight thesis, building for key moments, and protecting core usability during enhancement.

nodes.name: distill.md
nodes.summary: Simplification workflow assessing interface complexity, planning reductions across information architecture, visuals, layout, interactions, content, and code, then verifying outcomes.

nodes.name: doctor.md
nodes.summary: Skill maintenance pass that runs health checks, acts on findings by severity, enforces deprecated field handling, and supports monorepo-wide validation with opt-out controls.

nodes.name: document.md
nodes.summary: Design documentation workflow for producing DESIGN.md and .impeccable/design.json via scan or seed modes, including token frontmatter schema, sidecar rules, and confirmation steps.

nodes.name: extract.md
nodes.summary: Six-step design system extraction flow to discover existing patterns, plan component extraction, enrich tokens, migrate usage, and document the resulting system.

nodes.name: generate.md
nodes.summary: UI generation workflow parsing user requests, reusing existing pages where possible, generating new screens, and closing with acceptance criteria.

nodes.name: harden.md
nodes.summary: Production hardening guide covering text overflow, internationalization, error handling, edge cases, input validation, accessibility resilience, performance, and verification strategies.
